sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Finished portrait 4:5 illustration for a beautiful premium mobile puzzle, target1280x1600. Cozy dimensional storybook digital painting, subtly visible painterly textures, natural upper-left sunshine, beautifully shaped objects and readable local detail, not a photograph. No text, watermark, border, UI, logos or recognizable city landmarks. Fully painted attractive clean background, no holes/placeholders. A cheerful painter's studio with brushes, open paint tubes, stretched canvases with unfinished abstract landscapes and a wooden easel, gently elevated three-quarter view. Dominant soft violet #AE92C6 on walls, a large violet worktable covering lower half and muted purple cushion; warm cream accents. Large window upper-left with bare brass curtainrod and no curtain in its left half. On rear shelf upperright near x83%,y36% a small clay plantpot with short bare stem and no foliage. On table front center near x52%,y72%, one tiny empty glazed lavender budvase with open mouth. A small closed sketchbook lies lower-right at x77%,y84%, tied in plain cotton cord but no ribbon bow yet. A slim nail on the easel's left upright around x34%,y48% for later hanging fabric tie. Distinct tactile paintbrush bristles, ceramic palette, wood and canvas. Later five separate details: short ivory window curtain, leafy plant sprig, tiny cosmos flower in vase, violet bow on sketchbook, narrow fabric tie hanging from easel nail. Leave those exact five details absent, all surfaces complete.
